publisher: First Ink / Pan Macmillan (UK); Amulet Books / Abrams (US)
en: In the Kingdom of Thaletal, powerful Players fight a Great Game by moving whole castles across the land like chess pieces. Fifteen-year-old Burr's quiet village is thrown into chaos when a new castle lands on its doorstep, and then the castle itself is carried off to a far corner of the kingdom, where the Magpie Maiden's birds come to collect debts. Haunted by his father's execution after a failed rebellion, Burr teams up with his sisters, his friends and a sharp-witted heiress to survive. A twisty, inventive fantasy about power, loyalty and who really pays for war, for teens and adult fantasy fans alike.
zh: 喺Thaletal王國，有權有勢嘅「棋手」玩一場「大博弈」，竟然將成座城堡當棋子咁喺地圖上搬嚟搬去。十五歲嘅Burr住喺一條平靜小村，點知一座新城堡突然落喺村口，打亂晒所有人嘅生活；之後城堡仲被搬去王國嘅偏遠角落，嗰度有「喜鵲少女」嘅喜鵲上門追債。佢爸爸喺一場失敗嘅叛亂之後被處決，Burr同兩個家姐、朋友，仲有一位精明嘅女繼承人聯手求存。故事充滿轉折，講權力、忠誠同戰爭代價，少年同成年奇幻迷都啱睇。

reviews.d: Layered and lush; an expertly woven tapestry of a fantasy, recommended for 13 to adult.
reviews.dz: 層次豐富、文筆華麗，編織得好精巧，十三歲到成人都啱。

reviews.d: An incredible fantasy: beautifully written with a compelling pace; recommended for readers aged 12 and up.
reviews.dz: 出色奇幻小說，文筆優美、節奏吸引，建議十二歲以上。

reviews.d: Calls it an outstandingly creative and unusual fantasy novel.
reviews.dz: 評為極有創意、與眾不同嘅奇幻小說。

reviews.d: Stellar writing and characters; some violence (an execution), very little romance or swearing; fine for 12+.
reviews.dz: 文筆同角色一流；有少量暴力（處決），幾乎冇情愛粗口，十二歲以上合適。

ken: Castles moving like chess pieces, debt-collecting magpies and a hero who outwits the powerful: pure imagination.
kzh: 城堡好似棋子咁郁、喜鵲上門追債，主角以智鬥強權，想像力爆燈！
